address: 780 Estero Blvd,  Fort Myers Beach, Florida, United States
description:
Located on the North End of Fort Myers Beach Bel-Air Beach Club is in a prime location to meet anyones’ needs. This 2BR 2BA resort is just a block away from “Times Square”. Guests can enjoy live music, street performers, local shopping, and some of the best food the island has to offer.

In the evening enjoy the sunset from the back deck, with grills, a fridge, sink and plenty of space for the whole family to sit together and soak in the last remaining rays of the day (please note: the resort’s general grounds may still be in the process of reconstruction since Hurricane Ian in 2022). After dinner on the deck or a evening downtown come back to a spacious two bedroom, two bath unit. Washers and Dryers are provided in each unit. Throw a load in and enjoy the sound of the gulf waters while sitting on your private screened-in patio.

After a relaxing evening, and a good nights sleep, wake up to morning coffee on the deck again, and the sounds of the seagulls and waves welcoming you to another beautiful day at Bel-Air Beach Club on Fort Myers Beach!
